== Course of events ==

Alice's tribulations had been many: she had swollen to a size most enormous within the confines of a small room, then shrunk back to her natural proportions by means of enchanted cakes that fell like pebbles through the window.

The White Rabbit and his companions, arriving upon the scene, sought to extract her. During this extraction, the creature Bill was present, and Alice delivered a vigorous kick that sent him down the chimney—a turn of events that concluded the matter with sudden finality.

The bewildered Rabbit, his confusion yet to deepen, would soon mistake Alice for his housemaid Mary Ann.
